subject: Acme Health SOC 2 discovery - post-call recap and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Jacobs <tom.jacobs@acmehealth.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Acme Health SOC 2 discovery - post-call recap and next steps

Tom / Samantha —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have alignment and clear next steps for your security and procurement teams. Below are the key pain points you called out, what we discussed as possible mitigations, and owners / tentative dates.

Summary of pain points / goals:
- SOC 2 Type II evidence needed for vendor approval (audit period: most recent 12 months).
- Per-tenant audit logs and full API request logs for security investigations and eDiscovery.
- Extended log retention for security team (default 90d today, need up to 1 year; possibility of 7+ years for specific HIPAA retention requirements).
- Data residency and encryption: customer-managed KMS, HSM for key control, and regional hosting.
- DPA and contractual language around data deletion, backups, and breach notification timelines.
- Recent pen test summary and remediation timeline.

What Redwood can provide / notes from call:
- SOC 2 Type II report (we can share redacted report). See attachment: redwood_soc2_type2_2026.pdf and Drive link below.
- Audit logs: we expose API access logs and admin audit events; logs can be exported to your SIEM (S3/CloudWatch/BigQuery) or provided as on-demand exports.
- Retention: default 90 days; we offer configurable retention tiers. For Acme, we can provision a 1-year retention tier for logs and discuss archival for longer retention (7+ years) as a paid add-on.
- Encryption & keys: support for customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS / GCP CMEK) and BYOK workflows; all data at rest encrypted with per-customer keys where requested.
- DPA: we have an enterprise DPA draft (attached: dpa-redwood-v2.docx).
- Pen test: summary attached (pen-test-summary-2025.pdf); we can provide more detailed findings under NDA if needed.

Action items / next steps:
1) Marissa (Redwood) — Send redacted SOC 2 Type II report, latest pen test summary, and DPA draft (today). [Attachments included].
2) Tom (Acme) — Confirm the required log retention window (confirm: 1 year vs. 7 years) and whether exports to your SIEM satisfy the retention requirement. (ETA: Tue, 4/20)
3) Neha (Redwood security) & Rishi (Redwood solutions) — Schedule a 60-minute security deep-dive to walk through audit logs, KMS integration, and backup/deletion workflows. Proposed slots: Wed 4/21 10:00 AM PT or Thu 4/22 9:00 AM PT.
4) Procurement — Once DPA language is reviewed, we can generate a DocuSign for signature and start procurement/Ops paperwork.

If that all looks right, I’ll send the attachments and book the deep-dive for Wed 4/21 10am PT.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_soc2_type2_2026.pdf; pen-test-summary-2025.pdf; dpa-redwood-v2.docx

From: Tom Jacobs <tom.jacobs@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 10:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme Health SOC 2 discovery - post-call recap and next steps

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and for sending the attachments. A few quick clarifications from our security and procurement teams after a brief review:

- For auditing: we need per-tenant API request logs with full request/response metadata retained for at least 1 year. Can you confirm whether Redwood logs include response metadata or just request headers/body?
- Retention: 1 year is our baseline; for PHI/clinical archives we may need 7 years in certain cases. Please confirm whether longer-term archival is available and rough pricing.
- Deletion & backups: we need written confirmation of backup retention periods and how deletion requests are propagated to backups (i.e., are backups immutable for N days?). Also need your SLA for data deletion on contract termination (max X days to purge customer data).
- Pen test: we’ll take the redacted summary; if we need to go deeper we'll sign an NDA.

Procurement asked for a single point of contact to coordinate the DPA/contract. Can you confirm who on Redwood will own that? Also, we prefer DocuSign for signature routing.

Appreciate it — if you can answer the above we’ll confirm the deep-dive slot.

—
Tom Jacobs
Director, Information Security | Acme Health
Tom.Jacobs@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Jacobs <tom.jacobs@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme Health SOC 2 discovery - post-call recap and next steps

Tom —

Appreciate the follow-up. Answers inline / summary below and next steps: 

- Logs: Redwood captures full API request metadata and request/response status codes; we do not store full response payloads by default for sensitive data, but can enable response payload logging for specific fields or endpoints under a compliance agreement. If your team needs full response payload retention we can discuss scope and masking.
- Retention: 1-year retention tier available (no code change) — archival for 7+ years is supported via our cold-archive add-on (S3 glacier or equivalent). I’ll include rough pricing in a follow-up note.
- Deletion & backups: Backups are snapshot-based. By default, immutable snapshots are retained for 30 days; we can shorten this on request or put in contractual deletion windows. On contract termination we commit to data purge within 60 days (configurable in the DPA). We’ll include the explicit purge timeline in the DPA draft.
- Pen test: happy to provide detailed findings under NDA. Attachments include the summary; full report available after NDA.
- POC / procurement contact: I’ll be your primary point of contact for contracting and procurement (Marissa Cole). For technical security questions and the deep-dive, Neha (security) and Rishi (solutions) will lead.

Deep-dive proposal: Wed 21 Apr 2027, 10:00 AM PT — I’ll hold the slot and send a calendar invite with a short agenda (audit log walk-through, KMS/BYO key flow, retention/backup, questions).

For convenience I’m re-attaching the SOC 2 redacted PDF and the pen test summary, plus the DPA draft. If you’d like, I can prepare an explicit answers doc for procurement with these items called out and a DocuSign-ready DPA.

Let me know and I’ll proceed.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
